name: 3M 2091 P100 Particulate Filters
summary: P100 particulate filters for approved 3M bayonet assemblies. The 2091 is distinct from 2097 and has no documented nuisance-level organic-vapor relief. Canadian package quantity remains unverified.
description: The 2091 is a particulate filter for certain oil and non-oil aerosols when used in a correctly selected and fitted approved respirator assembly. It is not a gas/vapor cartridge. Unlike the 2097, its manufacturer specifications do not list nuisance-level organic-vapor relief. The 6800 full-facepiece instructions list 2091 and describe using two matching filters. The recorded Canadian ASIN is B001D1JCK4, but the current model selection, seller and sale-pack quantity could not be independently checked.

specs.label: Model / filter class
specs.value: 3M 2091, P100 particulate filter; manufacturer model designation, not authentication of a delivered unit

specs.label: Particle scope
specs.value: Certain oil and non-oil airborne particles in an approved assembly selected for the assessed exposure

specs.label: Gas and vapor limitations
specs.value: Not a chemical cartridge; no nuisance-level organic-vapor relief is listed for 2091. Do not transfer 2097 features to this model

specs.label: 6800 compatibility
specs.value: Listed in the 3M 6000-series full-facepiece instructions; use two matching 2091 filters in an approved configuration. Mechanical fit alone does not establish hazard suitability

specs.label: Oxygen and atmosphere
specs.value: Supplies no oxygen; not for oxygen-deficient, unknown or immediately dangerous to life or health (IDLH) atmospheres

specs.label: Inspection and replacement
specs.value: Inspect before use, follow the package use-by date and applicable time limits, and leave the contaminated area to replace damaged, soiled or difficult-to-breathe-through filters

safetyNotes: The 2091 filters particulates; it does not replace cartridges for hazardous gases or vapors. Do not attribute the 2097 nuisance-level organic-vapor feature to 2091.
Use two matching 2091 filters on a compatible facepiece only in the approved configuration selected for the actual contaminant and concentration.
These filters supply no oxygen. Do not use in oxygen-deficient, unknown or immediately dangerous to life or health (IDLH) atmospheres.
Required fit testing, training and a user seal check are essential; facial hair and damaged components can compromise the seal. A seal check does not replace a fit test.
No universal radiation, biological-agent or chemical-weapon protection is established. Particle filtration does not shield ionizing radiation or eliminate infection risk.
